data.name: Rogue Kingdom
data.detailed_description:
Each dungeon is procedurally generated with enemies, unique bosses and historical artifacts. These places and unique items all have their own history ledger - and their own destiny.

Build your own dungeon home with NPC Settlers and other players to help you in PvE defense and resource gathering. For solo players, NPC adventurers also appear, assisting you in keeping dungeons clear.


The one unified world is made of series of (virtually infinite) dungeons. This world has persistent 100 years of pre-generated history and current ongoing progress. Every 14 days in real life, 1 year passes in Rogue Kingdom. Every mined tile, every started (or destroyed) settlement is forever etched in the whole history.

KEY FEATURES

  • Procedurally generated world and unique artifacts with its own history and events simulation. Every dungeon, every NPC and every artifact has its own 100 years of pre-generated history, while game chronology is simulated into the ongoing present. When you launch the game and enter a dungeon - it is not the same dungeon everyone else will be joining. It is uniquely generated dungeon that you can claim.

  • Game is always online. You can easily join or invite your friends to any dungeon through Steam invites. Invite them into your guild, or accidently run into another players dungeon while exploring networks of dungeons across the node-like map. All dungeons are connected to each other and reachable through exploration.

  • Every dungeon is just one simulated instance out of many other dungeons available for players to join, clear, and even settle, becoming its ruler. You can endlessly explore new dungeons, and crank up the difficulty by going deeper. Depth System is the main difficulty dial in this game. Level 20 players are recommended to stay in range of Depth 10-30.

  • Your claimed dungeon gradually turns into an underground "town" with other adventurers and workers visiting and living there. You can help them grow their workshops such as Tavern, Forge, Barracks. Or you may leave the workers to gather resources by themselves while you keep them safe from respawning monster population.

  • Follower Companions and Quest givers. Also you may have a rare chance to meet unique legendary historical figures, you can even recruit them as companions and settlers. Companions follow you around and help you in combat, or stay at one of your home dungeons to defend it.

  • Increasing your Mining and Crafting skills will also allow you to craft better spells and upgraded weapons for use in combat, while helping with growth of your settlement.

  • Be careful of producing Cheese in high level depths. Strange cultists have obsession with it. Nobody knows why exactly.

Rogue Kingdom is receiving weekly content updates and rapidly accepting player feedback, requests, and critique.

Join our Discord Server linked here on right of the page to chat with developer and other players, and follow the progress of additions into the game.

data.short_description: Online roguelike with every dungeon persistently simulated! Change the world by your actions: Claim dungeons, settle the colonists, and defend it.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 2.0GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon Mac
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
